definitions.explanation: Luggage that passengers are allowed to bring into the aircraft cabin with them, typically stored in overhead bins or under seats.

examples.japanese: {機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}みは1{個|こ}までです。
examples.english: You can have one piece of carry-on luggage.

examples.japanese: {機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}みのサイズを{確認|かくにん}する。
{液体|えきたい}は{機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}みに{制限|せいげん}がある。
examples.english: There are restrictions on liquids in carry-on luggage.

notes:
FORMS:
{機内|きない} (inside the aircraft) + {持|も}ち{込|こ}み (bringing in)

SIZE/WEIGHT LIMITS:
{機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}み luggage typically has size and weight restrictions. These vary by airline but commonly include:
- {縦|たて}×{横|よこ}×{奥行|おくゆ}き{合計|ごうけい}115cm{以内|いない}
- {重量|じゅうりょう}10kg{以内|いない}

LIQUID RESTRICTIONS:
{液体物|えきたいぶつ}は100ml{以下|いか}の{容器|ようき}に{入|い}れ、1L{以下|いか}の{透明袋|とうめいぶくろ}にまとめる{必要|ひつよう}がある。

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}み: carry-on (brought into cabin)
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}: checked baggage (stored in cargo)

RELATED WORDS:
- {手荷物|てにもつ}: hand luggage
- {機内|きない}: inside the aircraft
- {持|も}ち{込|こ}み{禁止|きんし}: prohibited items
